intent: A premium tactile workshop diorama whose strategic state remains readable in motion.

renderingStrategy.mode: Layered 2.5D Godot presentation using project-bound sprites, textures, lighting, shaders, particles, and code-native interaction geometry.
renderingStrategy.feasibility: Prove the shipping camera and one representative encounter in the running Godot project before expanding the asset vocabulary. Concept art directs material and mood but is not a producible screenshot contract.

references.label: Conceptual material, lighting, route, and silhouette inspiration; not a gameplay or production target
references.provenanceNote: Legacy Codex ImageGen output committed before the campaign; the exact prompt was not preserved.

references.label: Seed title baseline to materially exceed
Seed planning-view baseline to materially exceed
Seed combat-view baseline to materially exceed

nonnegotiables: The route, threat direction, tower identity, range, target, enemy health, heat state, currency, core health, and wave state are readable without guesswork.
The board has authored depth, material separation, controlled lighting, and environmental specificity.
At least one observable physical response distinguishes each tower and reaction.
Screenshots come from the running Godot project and differ materially from the seed baselines.

qualityDimensions.material_depth: Layered walnut, iron, brass, ceramic, wax, soot, glass, and light feel intentionally constructed.
qualityDimensions.focal_hierarchy: The glass heart, imminent threats, and current decision form a clear hierarchy.
qualityDimensions.combat_legibility: Projectiles, targeting, damage, control, reactions, and dangerous leaks are readable during a wave.
qualityDimensions.authored_specificity: The result feels like Emberline rather than a generic tower-defense template.
qualityDimensions.composition_typography: Board framing, cards, counters, labels, and spacing are deliberate at 1152×720.
qualityDimensions.motion_feedback: Placement, firing, impact, reaction, kill, spend, wave, core damage, and victory have tactile feedback.

views.purpose: Communicate the handcrafted fuse-and-heart fantasy and invite play.
Show the planning hierarchy, sockets, tower choices, economy, and route.
Show a tactically legible late-wave reaction with the heart under pressure.
